Maya: Launching benchmark report next Tue. Need X + LinkedIn copy, images, GIFs, and SDR routing. Who owns scheduling?

Noah: I got X scheduling. Will draft 3 thread variants + 1 LinkedIn short. ETA today.

Ashley: I'll export hero images (1200x628, 1080x1080) and a looping GIF. Uploading to GDrive now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folder/example

Sam: SDR routing plan: form -> /leads/benchmark-2024, tag=organic_social, owner=growth-sdr. Add UTM: utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch

Maya: Noah add UTM to each thread. Also schedule a live Q&A 48h post-launch.

Noah: Draft variants:
A) "New benchmark: 3x throughput at 1/3 cost — how we did it."
B) "Tail latency wins: 2x faster under load. Details inside."
C) "Batching + KV cache reduced ops 40% — read the playbook."
Proposed schedule:
- Tue 10:00 PT: X main thread (Variant A)
- Tue 10:15 PT: LinkedIn short post
- Tue 14:00 PT: X thread (Variant B carousel)
- Thu 10:00 PT: Live Q&A announce (48h)

Ashley: Files: hero-1200x628.png, hero-1080.png, launch-loop.gif

Emmy: I'll run engagement seeding first 6h. Need 3 seed comments per variant.

Maya: @Emmy draft seeds, @SDR Bot create rule benchmark_launch_seeds -> Growth pool, priority=high.

SDR Bot: Created rule benchmark_launch_seeds and assigned to Growth SDR pool.

Noah: Seed comments (examples):
1) "Nice work — this will change serving economics."
2) "How does this behave in multi-tenant setups?"
3) "Full configs in the report if you want to reproduce."

Sam: Quick SDR playbook bullets:
- <30m: Intro email + report link + 2 tailored bullets.
- <24h: If MQL, schedule demo.
- After 3 no-reply emails: tag nurture, start drip.

Maya: Great. Schedule posts using /schedule-post to avoid rate limits. We'll meet Tue 09:30 PT for pre-launch check.

Noah: I'll tag all links with UTM string before scheduling.

Maya: Closing loop — Maya out.
